# Version 4.153.0
> **Chrome m153 update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m153 with current upstream correctness fixes. Linux applications that rely on implicit font fallback should review the changed fallback behavior before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path, which can change fallback glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic selection matters.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome m153 and incorporates current upstream bug, correctness, and buffer upload fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Improves HarfBuzzSharp native build diagnostics without changing its managed binding surface.
